name: Xenogears Decompilation
description: Matching decompilation of Xenogears (PSX, SLUS-006.64) plus a native PC port under pc_port/. Field load path and menu nav arc are largely working; current pressure is red ROM pins vs port work.
promptRules:
Never modify original decomp source under asm/ or src/ without matching evidence.
Confirm matches via the matching-build command before claiming a function is done.
Prefer minimal diffs; the PC port lives entirely under pc_port/.
